# CL Growth Academy

> CL Growth Academy is a founder-led growth practice run by Chris Lapa in Sydney, Australia. It helps NDIS and aged care providers get found and get chosen: marketing channels to bring in enquiries, plus referral partnerships and enquiry handling so those enquiries turn into clients.

Contact: chris@thegrowthacademy.com.au, +61 431 584 725

## Services

- [How we help](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/how-we-help.html): the four-step process (audit, strategy, execution, reporting) and the ways to work together: done for you, done with you coaching, one-off workshops and Managed Growth
- [NDIS marketing hub](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/): how the seven channels work together across getting found and getting chosen
- [Managed Growth](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/managed.html): every channel run as one plan by a senior growth strategist, monthly retainer, quarterly strategy reviews
- [NDIS SEO](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/seo.html): local search, Google Business Profile, content and AI search visibility
- [NDIS Google Ads](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/ads.html): search campaigns, landing pages, call and form tracking
- [NDIS social media ads](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/social-ads.html): Meta campaigns, creative and retargeting
- [Email marketing](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/email.html): enquiry sequences, referrer nurture and newsletters
- [Social and content](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/social.html): content calendar, platform strategy and posting
- [Referrals and partnerships](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/referrals.html): support coordinator, allied health and hospital discharge relationships, and referral tracking
- [Sales and enquiry process](https://thegrowthacademy.com.au/ndis-marketing/sales-process.html): response time, intake conversations, follow-up and team coaching
